sources.title: 2026 NFL Draft Profile: Zach Durfee
sources.description: Washington’s defensive front has undergone a steady evolution over the past few seasons, and few players better represent that transition than edge rusher Zach Durfee. A late-blooming, somewhat unconventional prospect, Durfee enters the 2026 NFL Draft as one of the more intriguing upside plays among Day 2/Day 3 defensive front-seven candidates.
